subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar add a permanent top-level, spend-first Usage & Spend pane with cross-provider and model rankings?
rationale: The dashboard fits CodexBar’s spend mission, but VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and this proposal establishes a substantial new information architecture and maintenance surface.

options.title: Approve the dedicated pane
options.body: Keep the top-level dashboard, reuse shared history and chart primitives where practical, and require sanitized runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow into existing surfaces
options.body: Expose aggregate totals through the current overview or provider UI instead of adding another top-level Settings destination.

options.title: Decline the dashboard
options.body: Close the draft if cross-provider spend ranking is not a desired permanent product surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Keep the top-level dashboard, reuse shared history and chart primitives where practical, and require sanitized runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available decision owner for a VISION.md-gated permanent Settings feature.
